title: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition: attackers can run commands on it
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 25 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched.

category.label: Website or online store
category.why: It runs public websites, online stores or the software behind them.
category.doThis: Ask whoever runs your website or store to update it.

summary: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Oct 23, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
